sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण भरद्वाजो महामुनिः ।प्रत्युवाच रघुश्रेष्ठं स्मितपूर्वं प्रहृष्टवत् ।। ६.१२७.३ ।।
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa bharadvājo mahāmuniḥ ।pratyuvāca raghuśreṣṭhaṁ smitapūrvaṁ prahṛṣṭavat ।। 6.127.3 ।।

translations.english: When Rama had spoken that way to the great sage, Bharadwaja was delighted and with a smiling look replied.
